gameplay.title: Gameplay
gameplay.objectiveDesc: Run as far as possible while avoiding enemies and collecting power-ups. Your distance traveled is your score.
gameplay.enemiesDesc: Samurais appear every 50m and shoot shurikens. Shoot them 3 times to defeat them. Ninjas and bosses appear at higher distances.
gameplay.powerUpsDesc: Collect power-ups to gain temporary advantages: Shield (protection), Infinite Ammo (unlimited shots), Jump Boost (higher jumps), Slow Motion (slows enemies), Multi Shot (multiple projectiles).

tips.title: Tips
tips.tip1: Time your jumps carefully to avoid enemies and obstacles
tips.tip2: Save your rice rockets for difficult situations
tips.tip3: Collect power-ups whenever possible to increase your survival chances
tips.tip4: The difficulty increases every 1000m - be prepared for more challenging enemies

welcome.title: Welcome to Rise Dash! 🎮
welcome.description: Get ready for an exciting adventure! Let's take a quick tour to help you get started.

gameOverview.title: Game Overview 🎯
gameOverview.description: Rise Dash is a fast-paced action game where you control a character jumping through obstacles, collecting power-ups, and defeating enemies to achieve the highest score possible.

controls.title: Controls 🎮
controls.description:
• SPACE or UP ARROW: Jump
• LEFT/RIGHT ARROWS: Move horizontally
• Mouse: Aim and shoot
• Collect power-ups to enhance your abilities!

objectives.title: Objectives 🎯
objectives.description:
• Survive as long as possible
• Collect sushi for points
• Defeat enemies (samurai, ninjas, bosses)
• Avoid obstacles and enemy projectiles
• Complete daily challenges for rewards

powerUps.title: Power-Ups ⚡
powerUps.description:
• 🛡️ Shield: Temporary invincibility
• 🔫 Infinite Ammo: Unlimited shooting
• 🦘 Jump Boost: Higher jumps
• ⏰ Slow Motion: Slower enemies
• 🎯 Multi Shot: Multiple projectiles

scoreSystem.title: Score System 📊
scoreSystem.description:
• Sushi collection: +10 points each
• Enemy defeats: +50 to +200 points
• Survival time: +1 point per second
• Power-up usage: Bonus multipliers
• Daily streaks: Extra rewards!

navigation.title: Navigation 🧭
navigation.description: Use the menu buttons at the top to navigate between different sections of the game. Each section has unique features and rewards!

profileSection.title: Profile Section 👤
profileSection.description: View your game statistics, achievements, and progress. Track your best scores, total playtime, and unlock special rewards as you improve!

leaderboardSection.title: Leaderboard 🏆
leaderboardSection.description: Compete with other players! Check the global leaderboard to see how you rank and challenge yourself to reach the top positions.

shopSection.title: Shop 🏪
shopSection.description: Purchase power-ups and upgrades using your earned points. Stock up on useful items to enhance your gameplay and achieve higher scores!

dailyStreakSection.title: Daily Streak 🎰
dailyStreakSection.description: Play daily to maintain your streak and earn special rewards! The longer your streak, the better the rewards. Don't break the chain!

complete.title: You're All Set! 🚀
complete.description: Congratulations! You now know everything you need to start your Rise Dash adventure. Jump in and start playing - good luck!
